resolved_parsed_fields.name: AMI超导磁体
resolved_parsed_fields.description: AMI超导磁体用于实验中产生和稳定控制磁场，通常由磁体电源驱动，并基于电流与磁场换算关系进行设定与调节。该类设备常用于低温物理、量子器件与材料表征等需要高稳定外加磁场的场景。
resolved_parsed_fields.description_en: An AMI superconducting magnet used to generate and stably control magnetic fields in experiments, typically driven by a magnet power supply and configured through a current-to-field conversion relationship. It is commonly used in scenarios requiring stable external fields, including cryogenic physics, quantum-device experiments, and materials characterization.
